title: Navy gun-camera videos off San Diego
summary: John Harrington tells of Navy gun-camera videos off San Diego, about undated at Off San Diego, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I see on television with these Navy gun cameras that are picking up off San Diego, the the thing traveling at warp speed, diving into the ocean.

plain: John Harrington, who appears as a former US Secretary of Energy, recalls seeing Navy videos on television, filmed by the cameras mounted on fighter jets off San Diego, California. He says they showed an object moving at enormous speed and diving into the ocean. To him, it suggested craft with abilities far beyond known aircraft.
